description: FastAPI router module for managing 'activities' in a CRM backend, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting activities.

methods.name: _paginate
methods.description: Helper function to paginate query results.

methods.name: list_activities
methods.description: Endpoint to list activities with optional filtering by client ID.

methods.name: create_activity
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new activity linked to a client.

methods.name: get_activity
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific activity by ID.

methods.name: update_activity
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing activity.

methods.name: delete_activity
methods.description: Endpoint to delete an activity by ID.
